content.rationale: S3-oplog fixes the read — an operation's place in the jj op log, the entries the run window between two head reads carries, each with the workspace it is attributed to, and which workspace that work belongs to, feeding markers' read-run-read bracketing; S5-observation (urqytyqn) fixes that every read here is observational — the head, the window and the invoking workspace are read with `--ignore-working-copy`, so none of them snapshots or updates the working copy, and settling belongs to the bracket, before the window; M-layout places the module flat at src/oplog.rs. `jj op log` carries a template, so this fixes the machine-readable form and returns the head operation id and the window's entries; the op log does not say which workspace is invoking, so this fixes that read too — `jj workspace list` matched by the root the invoking workspace reports for itself, both read with the working copy left alone — and an entry answers to the invoking workspace by that name. Failures are carried as values with their evidence (S3-err); bracketing around an operation is the markers layer's concern.
